Siemens and NVIDIA Partnership

Siemens and NVIDIA are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world. With a partnership focused on industrial AI, digital twins, and AI infrastructure, we are transforming industries, buildings and grids, and transportation systems end to end.

The partnership between Siemens and NVIDIA is shaping a more efficient and resilient future – enabling organizations to scale production, improve product quality, and adapt swiftly to changing market conditions.
What makes the partnership unique
The origins of the Siemens and NVIDIA partnership
. And now, as AI transforms every corner of the physical world, our partnership spans every layer of the transformation.

Siemens and NVIDIA are putting AI to work in product design and production – and helping build the AI factories that power it. Ten months after expanding their partnership at CES, the companies are delivering new products and reporting measurable results from joint projects.
Siemens partners with NVIDIA to advance AI-driven, autonomous factories
To meet the increasing energy demands of the AI era, Siemens has partnered with NVIDIA to develop a reference design for the latest Vera Rubin DSX AI factory.

Siemens today announced an expansion of its strategic partnership with NVIDIA to deliver self-verifying agentic AI workflows to EDA, helping semiconductor and printed circuit board (PCB) engineering teams move from autonomous task orchestration toward more trusted, continuously validated engineering outcomes.

HMND 01 Alpha is purpose-built for industrial environments with advanced manipulation capabilities. Siemens’ and NVIDIA’s strategic partnership to build fully AI-driven, adaptive manufacturing sites delivers real-world milestone with testing of humanoid robot at Siemens factory in Erlangen, Germany.

At Hannover Messe 2026, Siemens presents the next generation of its Industrial Automation DataCenter, a custom-configured data center for all IT requirements in production. This turnkey solution and AI-ready platform is in partnership with NVIDIA and in collaboration with Palo Alto Networks.

As part of their long-standing strategic partnership, NVIDIA and Siemens have mastered a task previously considered impossible, capturing tens of trillions of cycles over a span of just a few days by taking advantage of Siemens’ Veloce proFPGA CS scalable and performance-optimized hardware architecture and combining it with NVIDIA’s performance-optimized chip architecture.
Siemens and NVIDIA expand strategic partnership to build Industrial AI operating system
How do manufacturers benefit from the Siemens-NVIDIA partnership?

As a result of the partnership, manufacturers can also improve their factory operations, with AI-powered maintenance and increasingly intelligent automation. And they can continuously improve their efficiency, productivity, and sustainability.

As AI workloads place unprecedented demand on data centers, Siemens and NVIDIA have teamed up to develop the next generation of AI infrastructure. Together with our partners, we are engineering integrated systems from the chip to the rack, from the building to the grid. We are enabling high-efficiency, gigawatt-scale AI factories that operate reliably in real-world conditions.
